title: add benchmark-lab memory-profiling runners and reporting pipeline v145
author: Ava Chen
description: Motivation: memory regressions have been difficult to track across model variants and quantization profiles. This PR adds a set of memory-profiling workload runners (cold-start and steady-state samplers), integrates them into the benchmark-lab reporting pipeline, and emits memory baseline artifacts used by the profiler dashboard. Summary of changes: 1) new runners: benchlab.runners.memory.{cold_start,steady_state} — sample realistic request patterns and capture peak RSS, GPU reserved memory, and allocator fragmentation metrics; 2) reporting pipeline: aggregate memory traces into per-model, per-quantization, per-sequence-length baselines and upload artifacts to the telemetry bucket; 3) CI and e2e test harness updates: lightweight unit tests and a smoke runner to validate end-to-end uploads in the staging pipeline; 4) docs: updated benchmark lab README and profiling baseline how-to. Checklist: - [x] implement memory runners and instrumentation - [x] add pipeline DAG and reporting tasks - [x] add unit and e2e smoke tests - [x] update docs and examples - [x] add Linear tickets and link to dashboards Testing notes: Local unit tests added under benchlab/tests; run ./scripts/benchlab-smoke --staging to validate pipeline upload (requires staging credentials). Performance impact: runners are throttled and off by default; no production-serving codepaths changed. Rollout plan: merge to main, deploy benchlab pipeline in staging for one week, validate baselines against known-good models (see linked Linear tasks). Related: ENG-7345 (memory regression alerts), ENG-7420 (adaptive-batching memory alignment).

review_comments: Marcus Li (2025-02-16): Left a few nits on the memory_metrics API: prefer 'peak_rss_bytes' and include allocator tags. Also can we expose an optional prometheus exporter for the memory traces?
Ava Chen (2025-02-16): Reply: renamed metric to peak_rss_bytes and added allocator_tag. Added an optional Prometheus exporter behind config 'benchlab.memory.export_prometheus' (disabled by default).
Nina Patel (2025-02-17): Could the steady_state runner optionally warm the KV cache to better reflect real traffic? Suggest adding a '--warm-kv' flag.
Ava Chen (2025-02-17): Added --warm-kv flag to steady_state runner and documented behavior in profiling-baselines.md.
Diego Ramos (2025-02-18): Integration smoke failed once due to permissions on the staging telemetry bucket; re-run fixed it after infra applied bucket IAM change. Approving after successful re-run.
release_notes: Added memory profiling runners (cold_start and steady_state), reporting DAG to aggregate memory baselines, CI smoke job for benchlab staging, and docs for using memory baselines. Baselines will be emitted to the telemetry bucket and consumed by the profiler dashboard.
